rationale: The agent cancelled the entire order without authenticating the user, without confirming the order-changing action, and without first attempting the requested steps (split payment, identify/cancel the most expensive item, or switch to cheaper options). It also stated specific refund details (amount and last four of card) without any visible tool-based verification. Policy requires authentication, confirmation before writes, and acting only after appropriate checks; these were not followed. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
